title: The Winter Compass
author: Emrys Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Thornbury, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
